{{Quote|Sykes, you've just been drafted into the Trade Federation.|Captain Kael orders Gavyn Sykes to steal a gunboat|<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />}}
During the [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|Invasion of Naboo]] in [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], a temporarily disabled [[Trade Federation base]] was '''attacked''' as part of the [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] [[Naboo Resistance|resistance effort]]. Members of the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]]' [[Bravo Squadron/Legends|Bravo Squadron]], led by [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Kael (officer)|Kael]] and his [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]], [[Mission to the Naboo mountains|allied]] with a [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] [[Nal Raka Criminal Empire|organization]] and planned an offensive against the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]]. Their first victory was to [[Disruption of Comm 4|destroy]] [[Comm 4]], an [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] component of the Federation communications web providing a control signal to the base down on the [[Naboo/Legends|planet]].

With the control signal lost, the base went into hibernation and was vulnerable to attack. The pilots flew back down to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] and attacked the base, which consisted of multiple platforms spread throughout the area. The pilots were ambushed when the base reactivated and had to destroy a wall of [[airborne mine]]s to proceed further into the base. The group fought through the complex, facing the base's defenses, before blowing up the [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|deflector shield generator]] protecting the command center, which allowed [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Gavyn Sykes/Legends|Gavyn Sykes]] to land and steal a [[Ostracoda-class gunboat|gunboat]] to use as a decoy. His [[Wingmate/Legends|wingmen]] then left the site as Federation reinforcements arrived.

==Prelude==
{{Quote|Good work, people. We just put a Trade Federation base to sleep.|Captain Kael, to his team|<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />}}
In [[32 BBY/Legends|32 BBY]], the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]], led by a group of [[Neimoidian/Legends|Neimoidians]], [[Invasion of Naboo/Legends|invaded]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]] in response to a [[Senate Resolution BR-0371|trade dispute]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]], and the [[Royal Naboo Security Forces/Legends|Royal Naboo Security Forces]] defended their [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]].<ref name="The New Essential Chronology" /> Acting on intelligence gathered by [[Borvo]] the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]], the leader of a [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggling]] [[Nal Raka Criminal Empire|organization]], the [[Naboo Resistance|Resistance]] group led by [[Bravo Squadron/Legends|Bravo Squadron's]] [[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Kael (officer)|Kael]] went on their first offensive against the [[Trade Federation Droid Army/Legends|Trade Federation Droid Army]]. Borvo's [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenaries]] and the [[Naboo (people)/Legends|Naboo]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] [[Disruption of Comm 4|knocked]] out [[Comm 4]], an [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] [[Satellite/Legends|satellite]] that, as part of the Trade Federation comm web, rerouted the control signal to a [[Trade Federation base|Federation base]] down on the planet. After knocking out the satellite and forcing the base to hibernate, the five [[Starfighter/Legends|fighter]] pilots, flying [[N-1 starfighter/Legends|N-1 starfighters]] and [[Borvo the Hutt's starfighter|another type of ship]], dashed down to destroy the base itself. Kael ordered them to destroy all Federation targets.<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />

==The attack==
===Infiltration===
{{Quote|Destroy anything and everything that belongs to the Trade Federation.|Captain Kael, to his pilots, at the start of the attack|<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />}}
{{GameMechanics|legends=1|Star Wars: Episode I: Battle for Naboo}}
Approaching the canyon in which the base's multiple platforms were situated, the pilots destroyed several inactive [[Laser turret (Trade Federation)|laser turrets]]. They were blocked from further travel, however, by a wall of [[Airborne mine|airborne proximity mines]]. As they were attempting to disable the first three platforms of the base, the base reactivated much sooner than expected, and the turrets opened fire on the Resistance fighters. The pilots destroyed the turrets and the [[Mine/Legends|mines]], and proceeded into the next section of the base.<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />

===Destruction===
{{Quote|We have visitors.|Vedd Deviss, in reference to droid starfighter reinforcements|<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />}}
The pilots found and destroyed another gun platform before moving on to destroy a platform supporting a building. The building was protected by two [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]] in the [[Water/Legends|water]] and a nearby [[Missile launcher (Trade Federation)|missile launcher]]. When the area was cleared of Federation forces, Kael ordered his pilots to rejoin formation. As he led them toward the next part of the canyon, they were met by [[Vulture-class starfighter/Legends|Vulture droid starfighters]], about which Naboo pilot [[Vedd Deviss]] informed his compatriots. A [[C-9979 landing craft/Legends|C-9979 landing craft]] took off from the base at the same [[Time/Legends|time]].<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />

The Naboo coalition engaged the [[Droid starfighter/Legends|droid starfighters]] as they continued on to the next section of the base, where they found buildings protected by turrets, which they cleared as well. Moving along the canyon, they destroyed the next platform, which was protected by [[Ostracoda-class gunboat|''Ostracoda''-class gunboats]] in addition to [[Laser/Legends|laser]] turrets. Kael ordered his team to move on once the Federation presence in the area was annihilated.<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />

Naboo [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Gavyn Sykes/Legends|Gavyn Sykes]] then flew off the path and acquired [[advanced proton bomb]] technology in a burned-out building after clearing away the surrounding Federation defenses. As Sykes rejoined the formation, which was flying over a destroyed dome with Federation turrets nearby, the mercenary pilot [[Adela Tyché]] commented that the Trade Federation had been there already.<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />

===Control Center===
{{Quote|Good job, form up.|Captain Kael, to his pilots, after destroying a platform|<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />}}
Flying through the next part of the canyon, the Naboo pilots reached the base control center, where they planned to steal a Federation [[Gunboat (seafaring)|gunboat]]. The command center was protected by a [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shield]], which Sykes had to disable to steal the gunboat while Tyché provided supporting fire. Once the defenses were destroyed, Sykes landed his N-1 starfighter and absconded with a gunboat, shooting through a wall that blocked his path to the [[Andrevea River]]. The other fighters were unable to escort him, as Federation reinforcements were inbound. Kael ordered Sykes to continue, as the Captain surmised the Federation would think Sykes was an escaping Neimoidian.<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />
{{Endgame}}

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|Captain Kael, I've found the mining camp. The Trade Federation is using captured Naboo as slaves.''"<br />"''Do as much damage as you can and free the prisoners.|Sykes and Kael, as Sykes moves down the Andrevea River|<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />}}
With his stolen gunboat, Sykes traveled down the Andrevea River and reached several Federation camps holding [[Slavery/Legends|enslaved]] Naboo citizens, whom he and his team [[Liberation of enslavement camps|liberated]]. Eventually, Borvo [[Search for Captain Kael|betrayed]] the Naboo fighters and [[Death/Legends|killed]] Captain Kael, taking control of the rescued slaves. Sykes and his [[Wingmate/Legends|wingmen]] in turn [[Attack on Porso Hill|stopped the Hutt]] before [[Liberation of Camp Four|returning]] to fighting the Trade Federation.<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />

==Behind the scenes==
The attack on the disabled base appears in the seventh mission of the [[2000]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: Episode I: Battle for Naboo]]''. It is not necessary to destroy every Trade Federation emplacement, although this article assumes full game completion. During the course of the mission, picking up the advanced [[Proton bomb/Legends|proton bomb]] upgrade will fulfill the bonus objective and provide a technology boost to the player's craft for the rest of the game.<ref name="Star Wars: Battle for Naboo" />
